propositions: Author guides (writing-a-passing-plan.md and passing-code-review.md) fail to load when rebar is installed as a library/CLI and run against a project without a docs/ tree because explain_guide and explain_criterion resolve guide paths via config.repo_root() pointing to the consuming project instead of the rebar package.

Guides must be packaged as in-package canonical resources under src/rebar/_guides/ and read via importlib.resources to ensure they are accessible from any rebar installation regardless of repo_root context.

explain_guide(name) must resolve guide content via resources.files('rebar._guides') without a repo_root_path parameter, and explain_criterion(id) must render criterion sections from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() instead of reading docs/ files.
Existing external links to docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md and docs/passing-code-review.md must continue to resolve by keeping thin pointer files in the docs/ directory.
